sourceFile: 1. BRS-201506DT Report test VP improverment bending date 26.1.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable VP new lot validation exists, but the draft has incorrect changed-factor grouping and an invalid measurement outcome.
issues: Changed factor is garbled and misclassified as process condition.
Changed condition wrongly includes old lot values.
Normal lot reference is inconsistently handled or omitted from outcomes.
Measurement outcome is derived from a header/non-comparable row.
Decision row and function header context are not properly used.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to VP lot/material: new lot versus old lot, with normal as reference if retained.
Normalize condition names and remove duplicates.
Keep the three NG-rate result sections under one validation case.
Remove the measurement outcome unless real measurement rows exist.
Cite purpose, compare statement, each result header/data row, and decision row.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Data row citations are mostly sufficient, but header/decision context must be fixed and row 43 is not valid outcome evidence.
